strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Software muag khoom hauv tsheb thiab field sales
strings.tierB.home.description: Rau tuam txhab faib khoom: daim nqi, daim ntawv txais nyiaj hauv xov tooj, khoom hauv tsheb, sau nyiaj, txoj kev, xyuas khw. Siv tau offline, sync tom qab.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Saib xyuas koj cov neeg muag khoom txij thaum mus xyuas thawj lub khw mus txog thaum sau nyiaj zaum kawg
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales yog ib lub cloud platform rau kev muag khoom hauv tsheb (van sales) thiab field sales, tsim los rau cov tuam txhab faib khoom thiab muag khoom wholesale uas muaj neeg muag khoom mus ncig khw. Cov neeg muag khoom siv lawv lub xov tooj los ua thiab luam daim nqi thiab daim ntawv txais nyiaj, saib xyuas cov khoom hauv tsheb thiab sau tseg kev mus xyuas khw, thiab tus thawj saib xyuas (manager) pom kev muag, kev sau nyiaj thiab cov nyiaj uas cov neeg yuav khoom tseem tshuav tam sim ntawd.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Daim nqi los ntawm xov tooj
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Tus neeg muag khoom ua daim nqi ntawm tus neeg yuav khoom lub khw, thiab siv lub tshuab luam ntawv thermal Bluetooth luam tawm ua ntej nws tawm ntawm lub khw.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Sau nyiaj thiab nyiaj tshuav
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Txhua zaum them nyiaj muaj ib daim ntawv txais nyiaj uas muaj tus lej, txuas rau cov daim nqi uas nws them, thiab cov nyiaj tshuav thiab daim ntawv qhia nyiaj ntawm tus neeg yuav khoom hloov tshiab tam sim ntawd.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Lub luag hauj lwm rau khoom hauv tsheb
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: FieldSales suav cov khoom hauv txhua lub tsheb ib yam ib yam: thauj rau tsheb, muag tau, xa rov qab thiab tseem tshuav, yog li yog muaj qhov tsis sib npaug yuav pom tau tib hnub ntawd.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Txoj kev thiab kev mus xyuas khw
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Txhua zaum mus xyuas khw, app sau tseg qhov chaw, lub sij hawm thiab duab, thiab tus thawj saib xyuas pom txoj kev ntawm txhua tus neeg muag khoom kos rau ntawm daim ntawv qhia chaw.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Siv tau thaum tsis muaj internet
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Cov neeg muag khoom tseem muag tau txawm tsis muaj network. Cov ntaub ntawv tos hauv xov tooj. Thaum internet rov qab los, app nws tus kheej sync cov ntaub ntawv ntawd, thiab tsis muaj daim twg xa mus ob zaug.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Web dashboard rau tus thawj saib xyuas
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Kev muag, kev sau nyiaj, khoom xa rov qab, khoom hauv tsheb thiab kev ua hauj lwm ntawm cov neeg muag khoom nyob rau ib qho chaw, nrog lub luag hauj lwm thiab kev tso cai rau txhua tus neeg siv.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Qhia peb seb koj muag khoom li cas
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Thov daim ntawv qhia nqi los yog teem sij hawm sib tham. Peb saib koj cov neeg muag khoom, txoj kev, khoom thiab qhov koj xav tau rau daim nqi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Teeb tsa koj lub tuam txhab
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Ntxiv cov khoom, tus nqi, cov neeg yuav khoom thiab cov neeg muag khoom, thiab teeb tsa hom nyiaj thiab feem se ntawm koj lub teb chaws hauv settings.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Xa cov neeg muag khoom mus ua hauj lwm
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Cov neeg muag khoom nruab app rau Android los yog iPhone, thauj khoom rau hauv lawv lub tsheb thiab pib muag, luam daim nqi thiab sau nyiaj.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Saib kev ua hauj lwm thaum nws tab tom ua
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Web dashboard qhia kev muag, kev sau nyiaj, khoom hauv tsheb thiab kev mus xyuas khw thaum cov neeg muag khoom tseem nyob saum kev.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales yog ib lub cloud platform uas pab cov tuam txhab faib khoom thiab muag khoom wholesale saib xyuas lawv cov neeg muag khoom mus ncig khw. Nws siv tau rau kev muag khoom hauv tsheb (van sales), kev muag raws txoj kev (route sales), kev txais order ua ntej (pre-sales) thiab kev xa khoom ncaj qha mus rau khw (DSD). Cov neeg muag khoom ua thiab luam daim nqi, sau nyiaj thiab sau tseg kev mus xyuas khw los ntawm lawv lub xov tooj, thiab tus thawj saib xyuas saib kev muag, kev sau nyiaj, khoom hauv tsheb thiab nyiaj tshuav los ntawm web dashboard.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: FieldSales puas siv tau thaum tsis muaj internet?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Siv tau. App ntawm tus neeg muag khoom tseem ua hauj lwm thaum tsis muaj internet: tus neeg muag khoom ua thiab luam tau daim nqi thiab daim ntawv txais nyiaj, sau tseg kev mus xyuas khw thiab ntxiv tus neeg yuav khoom tshiab. Thaum internet rov qab los, app nws tus kheej sync txhua yam, thiab tsis muaj daim twg xa mus ob zaug. Muaj ib qho kev zam nyob hauv Saudi Arabia: cov tuam txhab uas qhib kev txuas e-invoicing yuav tsum muaj internet thaum ua daim nqi los yog daim xa khoom rov qab.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.q: FieldSales siv tau hauv cov teb chaws twg?
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales pab cov tuam txhab faib khoom hauv txhua lub teb chaws. Txhua lub tuam txhab teeb tsa nws hom nyiaj thiab feem se hauv settings, thiab daim nqi, daim ntawv txais nyiaj thiab cov ntawv qhia (report) siv cov ntawd. Lub tuam txhab FieldSales nyob hauv Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, thiab kev pib siv yog ua online los ntawm kev sib tham, WhatsApp thiab kev pab nyob deb.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales puas txuas nrog e-invoicing ntawm tsoom fwv?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Peb txhawb kev txuas Phase 2 nrog Fatoora platform ntawm ZATCA. Qhov no yog rau cov tuam txhab hauv Saudi Arabia. Hauv lwm lub teb chaws, FieldSales ua daim nqi nrog koj hom nyiaj thiab feem se, thiab kev txuas rau e-invoicing ntawm tsoom fwv lub teb chaws ntawd muaj yog thov, tom qab peb nrog koj kuaj saib lub teb chaws ntawd xav tau dab tsi. Sab nraum Saudi Arabia, peb tsis cog lus tias FieldSales yuav ua tau raws li tej kev cai ntawm ib lub teb chaws twg.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: FieldSales app muaj lus dab tsi?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Lub interface ntawm FieldSales app muaj tsuas yog lus Arab, lus Askiv, lus Fab Kis, lus Turkish thiab lus Suav xwb; tsis muaj lus Hmoob. Cov neeg muag khoom thiab tus thawj saib xyuas hloov tau lus ntawm lub interface, thiab daim nqi uas luam tawm muaj tau ib hom lus thib ob nrog rau hom lus tseem ceeb. Cov nplooj website ua lwm hom lus, suav nrog nplooj lus Hmoob no, tsuas yog txhais los qhia txog FieldSales xwb.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Thov daim ntawv qhia nqi, teem sij hawm sib tham los yog xa lus rau peb hauv WhatsApp. Peb kawm seb koj cov neeg muag khoom ua hauj lwm li cas, ces peb pab koj teeb tsa cov khoom, tus nqi, cov neeg yuav khoom thiab cov neeg muag khoom. Cov neeg muag khoom nruab app rau Android los yog iPhone, thiab tus thawj saib xyuas siv web dashboard hauv txhua lub browser. Koj tsuas xav tau smartphone xwb.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Lub interface ntawm FieldSales app muaj lus Arab, lus Askiv, lus Fab Kis, lus Turkish thiab lus Suav, tsis muaj lus Hmoob. Cov nplooj ua lwm hom lus tsuas piav txog FieldSales kom koj paub xwb.
strings.tierB.category.title: Software muag khoom hauv tsheb (van sales) | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Software muag khoom hauv tsheb thiab raws txoj kev: luam daim nqi los ntawm xov tooj, suav khoom hauv tsheb, sau nyiaj, mus xyuas khw. Siv tau offline.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Software muag khoom hauv tsheb rau cov tuam txhab faib khoom thiab muag khoom wholesale
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales yog software muag khoom hauv tsheb (van sales) rau cov tuam txhab uas lawv cov neeg muag khoom tsav tsheb thauj khoom mus muag raws txoj kev txhua hnub. Tus neeg muag khoom thauj khoom rau hauv tsheb, muag rau txhua lub khw, luam daim nqi, sau nyiaj thiab sau tseg khoom xa rov qab los ntawm ib lub app hauv xov tooj. Tus thawj saib xyuas pom tias txhua lub tsheb tau thauj dab tsi, muag tau dab tsi, sau tau nyiaj npaum li cas thiab tseem tshuav dab tsi.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Software muag khoom hauv tsheb yog dab tsi?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Software muag khoom hauv tsheb, uas kuj hu ua cash van los yog route sales software, yog siv rau hom kev muag khoom uas tus neeg muag khoom thauj khoom hauv tsheb thiab muag, xa khoom, ua daim nqi thiab sau nyiaj tib zaug thaum mus xyuas ib lub khw. Nws hloov cov phau ntawv sau daim nqi thiab kev hu xov tooj thaum xaus hnub. Nws sau tseg txhua zaum muag, them nyiaj thiab xa khoom rov qab ua ib daim ntaub ntawv, yog li khoom thiab nyiaj ntsuab sib piv tau tib hnub ntawd. Rau tus thawj saib xyuas, nws teb peb lo lus nug txhua hmo: txhua tus neeg muag khoom muag tau dab tsi, sau tau nyiaj npaum li cas, thiab txhua lub tsheb tseem tshuav dab tsi.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Ib hnub ua hauj lwm
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Txhua hnub pib nrog ib daim ntaub ntawv thauj khoom ntawm chaw khaws khoom mus rau hauv tsheb. Ntawm txhua lub khw, tus neeg muag khoom xaiv tus neeg yuav khoom hauv app, ntxiv cov khoom los ntawm daim ntawv teev los yog scan barcode, ua daim nqi thiab luam tawm nrog lub tshuab luam ntawv thermal. Nws sau tseg kev them nyiaj nrog daim ntawv txais nyiaj, thiab sau tseg khoom xa rov qab nrog nws qhov laj thawj. Thaum kawg ntawm hnub, nws muab cov khoom tseem tshuav hauv tsheb rov qab rau chaw khaws khoom. Thaum cov neeg muag khoom tseem ua hauj lwm, tus thawj saib xyuas saib tau kev muag, kev sau nyiaj thiab kev mus xyuas khw ntawm txhua tus neeg muag khoom hauv web dashboard yam tsis tas hu leej twg.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Tsim rau qhov chaw uas network tsis zoo
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Txoj kev xa khoom hla cov qab tsev (basement), thaj chaw hoobkas thiab cov zos uas network tsis zoo, xws li cov zos saum roob. FieldSales app ntawm tus neeg muag khoom khaws cov neeg yuav khoom, cov khoom thiab tus nqi rau hauv xov tooj, yog li tus neeg muag khoom ua thiab luam tau daim ntaub ntawv thaum tsis muaj internet. Txhua daim ntaub ntawv muaj ib tus code tshwj xeeb, yog li nws upload tsuas ib zaug xwb, txawm yog rov sim upload dua. Cov tuam txhab hauv Saudi Arabia uas qhib kev txuas e-invoicing yuav tsum muaj internet thaum ua daim nqi thiab daim xa khoom rov qab. Rau lawv, daim ntawv txais nyiaj, kev mus xyuas khw thiab tus neeg yuav khoom tshiab tseem siv tau thaum tsis muaj internet.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Sau nyiaj thiab lub luag hauj lwm rau khoom hauv tsheb
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Nyiaj ntsuab saum kev xav tau kev tswj zoo ib yam li khoom. Txhua zaum sau nyiaj muaj ib daim ntawv txais nyiaj uas muaj tus lej thiab txuas tau rau cov daim nqi uas nws them, thiab cov nyiaj tshuav ntawm tus neeg yuav khoom hloov tshiab tam sim ntawd. FieldSales suav khoom hauv tsheb ib yam ib yam: khoom thauj rho tawm khoom muag, ntxiv khoom xa rov qab thiab kev kho tus lej uas muaj ntaub ntawv, yog li tus thawj saib xyuas muab sib piv tau nrog kev suav tiag ua ntej tus neeg muag khoom mus tsev. Khoom xa rov qab muab faib tau ua khoom zoo, khoom puas los yog khoom pauv, thiab tus thawj saib xyuas txiav txim seb cov khoom rov qab puas yuav rov mus rau hauv khoom muag tau ntawm lub tsheb.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Haum rau leej twg
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales haum rau cov tuam txhab faib khoom thiab muag wholesale uas muag khoom siv txhua hnub (FMCG) xws li zaub mov, dej haus, khoom ntxuav thiab khoom siv tu cev, thiab rau txhua lub tuam txhab uas muaj neeg muag khoom mus xyuas cov khw raws txoj kev. Nws siv tau rau kev muag khoom hauv tsheb, kev txais order ua ntej (pre-sales) thiab kev xa khoom ncaj qha mus rau khw. Nws tsis yog ib qho ERP tiav: nws txuas rau koj lub accounting los yog ERP system los ntawm API. Tus thawj saib xyuas txiav txim seb txhua tus neeg muag khoom ua tau dab tsi, xws li txo nqi, muag qis dua tus nqi teev tseg los yog ntxiv tus neeg yuav khoom tshiab.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Muag khoom hauv tsheb thiab txais order ua ntej txawv li cas?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Thaum muag khoom hauv tsheb, tus neeg muag khoom nqa khoom nrog thiab xa khoom, ua daim nqi thiab sau nyiaj tib zaug. Thaum txais order ua ntej (pre-sales), tus neeg muag khoom sau order thiab chaw khaws khoom xa khoom tom qab. FieldSales siv tau rau ob hom, yog li ib lub tuam txhab siv tau kev muag khoom hauv tsheb rau qee txoj kev thiab txais order rau lwm txoj kev. Hauv ob hom no, daim nqi, kev sau nyiaj thiab nyiaj tshuav nyob hauv tib lub system, thiab tus thawj saib xyuas pom tag nrho hauv tib cov ntawv qhia (report).
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Thaum kawg ntawm hnub, kuv yuav suav khoom hauv tsheb kom sib npaug li cas?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales qhia, rau txhua yam khoom hauv txhua lub tsheb, tus lej thauj, muag, xa rov qab thiab tseem tshuav. Muab tus lej tseem tshuav sib piv nrog kev suav tiag, sau qhov txawv ua kev kho tus lej uas muaj ntaub ntawv, ces muab cov khoom seem rov qab rau chaw khaws khoom ib zaug. Hnub tom qab lub tsheb pib nrog tus lej meej thiab paub zoo.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Tus neeg muag khoom hauv tsheb xav tau cuab yeej dab tsi?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Ib lub smartphone, Android los yog iPhone. Lub tshuab luam ntawv thermal Bluetooth yog xaiv tau, thiab nws pab tus neeg muag khoom muab daim nqi los yog daim ntawv txais nyiaj luam tawm rau tus neeg yuav khoom. FieldSales tsis muag cuab yeej thiab tsis yuam ib hom tshuab luam ntawv twg. Tus thawj saib xyuas siv web dashboard hauv browser ntawm txhua lub computer los yog xov tooj.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales puas txuas tau rau peb lub accounting system?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Tau. FieldSales muaj API uas pub koj lub accounting los yog ERP system sib pauv cov neeg yuav khoom, cov khoom, daim nqi, daim ntawv txais nyiaj thiab kev txav khoom nrog lub platform. Koj pab neeg los yog koj tus kws IT ua qhov kev txuas raws li API documentation.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales raws lub teb chaws: hom nyiaj, se, e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales siv tau rau tuam txhab faib khoom thoob ntiaj teb. Saib hom nyiaj, se thiab e-invoicing ntawm txhua lub teb chaws hauv ib daim ntawv teev.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales pab cov tuam txhab faib khoom hauv txhua lub teb chaws. Txhua lub tuam txhab xaiv nws lub teb chaws, hom nyiaj thiab feem se hauv settings, thiab daim nqi, daim ntawv txais nyiaj thiab report ua raws li ntawd. Kev txuas e-invoicing ntawm tsoom fwv siv tau tam sim no hauv Saudi Arabia xwb. Hauv lwm lub teb chaws, nws muaj yog thov. Daim ntawv teev hauv qab no qhia, rau txhua lub teb chaws, hom nyiaj hauv zos, feem se muag khoom los yog VAT uas siv ntau, thiab kev txuas e-invoicing ntawm tsoom fwv puas siv tau lawm los yog muaj yog thov.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Peb txhawb kev txuas Phase 2 nrog Fatoora platform ntawm ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Hom nyiaj thiab feem se, txhua lub tuam txhab teeb tsa hauv nws cov settings. Feem se hauv daim ntawv teev no tsuas yog los qhia dav dav thiab tej zaum yuav hloov; thov nug koj tus kws pab tswv yim txog se kom paub tseeb txog txoj cai tam sim no. Kab (—) txhais tias tsis muaj feem se dav dav teev rau lub teb chaws ntawd.
strings.tierB.about.title: Txog FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales ua cloud software rau cov tuam txhab faib khoom uas muaj neeg muag khoom mus ncig khw. Tsim tsa xyoo 2026 hauv Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (lub npe lus Arab yog فيلد سيلز) yog ib lub cloud platform rau cov tuam txhab faib khoom thiab muag wholesale uas muaj neeg muag khoom mus ncig khw. Lub tuam txhab FieldSales tsim tsa xyoo 2026 thiab nyob hauv Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Nws pab cov tuam txhab hauv txhua lub teb chaws, thiab txhua lub tuam txhab teeb tsa hom nyiaj thiab feem se ntawm nws lub teb chaws hauv nws cov settings. Peb cov neeg siv yog cov tuam txhab uas muag thiab xa khoom los ntawm cov neeg muag khoom saum kev: cov tuam txhab faib khoom, cov tuam txhab muag khoom wholesale thiab cov chaw tsim khoom uas muaj lawv pab neeg muag khoom.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Peb ua ib lub system uas txuas ua ke rau tag nrho kev ua hauj lwm saum kev: daim nqi luam ntawm xov tooj, daim ntawv txais nyiaj thiab nyiaj tshuav, lub luag hauj lwm rau khoom hauv tsheb, txoj kev thiab kev mus xyuas khw nrog qhov chaw thiab duab, thiab web dashboard rau tus thawj saib xyuas. App ntawm tus neeg muag khoom siv tau rau Android thiab iPhone, tseem ua hauj lwm thaum tsis muaj internet, thiab sync thaum internet rov qab los. Cov tuam txhab txuas tau FieldSales rau lawv lub accounting los yog ERP system los ntawm API, kom tsis tas ntaus cov ntaub ntawv ob zaug.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Peb piav FieldSales raws li nws yog tiag. Peb txhawb kev txuas Phase 2 nrog Fatoora platform ntawm ZATCA. Kev txuas rau system ntawm tsoom fwv hauv lwm lub teb chaws muaj yog thov. Lub interface ntawm app muaj lus Arab, lus Askiv, lus Fab Kis, lus Turkish thiab lus Suav; tsis muaj lus Hmoob. Yog xav tham nrog peb, thov daim ntawv qhia nqi, teem sij hawm sib tham los yog xa lus rau peb hauv WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Tiv tauj FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Tham nrog pab neeg FieldSales: thov daim ntawv qhia nqi, teem sij hawm sib tham los yog tham hauv WhatsApp txog software muag khoom hauv tsheb.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Qhia peb seb niaj hnub no koj cov neeg muag khoom muag li cas thiab koj xav hloov dab tsi. Thov daim ntawv qhia nqi, teem sij hawm sib tham los yog xa lus hauv WhatsApp, thiab ib tug neeg hauv peb pab neeg yuav teb koj. Cov neeg uas twb siv FieldSales lawm kuj siv tau tib txoj kev tiv tauj no thov kev pab. Nws yuav pab tau yog koj qhia koj lub teb chaws, muaj pes tsawg tus neeg muag khoom, thiab lawv muag khoom hauv tsheb, txais order, los yog ua ob yam.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Teem sij hawm sib tham online nrog peb pab neeg. Peb yuav qhia ib hnub ua hauj lwm ntawm tus neeg muag khoom hauv app thiab tus thawj saib xyuas lub dashboard, siv cov piv txwv uas ze rau koj cov khoom thiab txoj kev, thiab teb koj cov lus nug txog kev teeb tsa.
